dedupe_keys.name: laboratory unidirectional bidirectional and dynamic ev charging profiles

description: TU Dortmund University's Smart Grid Technology Lab publishes laboratory profiles for unidirectional and bidirectional electric-vehicle charging. The Zenodo deposit lists raw and merged archives plus measurements and parameter-definition CSV files. Its description identifies static and dynamic charging scenarios, power and current, and harmonic and interharmonic emissions. The public release is free under CC BY 4.0. These traces can help calibrate charger behaviour or power-quality assumptions in distribution-grid simulations; data-urbanev-shenzhen-ev-charging supplies a separate field-demand comparison. A caveat is that controlled laboratory profiles do not give citywide arrival rates or driver choices. Vehicle, charger and analyzer configurations must be matched before transferring waveforms to another fleet. The own metadata and manifest were checked without downloading the raw measurements. Synchronization code is a separate archived software resource, so this record covers the observations and their parameter descriptions.
